frontmatter.name: kelid-ship
frontmatter.description: Finish a Kelid task — sync with main, verify, update docs, push the branch and open a pull request that closes the issue. Use when the user says "ship it", "open a PR", "I'm done", "push this", or similar.

frontmatter.name: kelid-sync
frontmatter.description: Bring the latest main into the current Kelid branch and resolve merge conflicts safely (migrations, package-lock, graphify outputs). Use when the user says "update from main", "sync", "pull the teammate's changes", or when a PR shows conflicts.
